<b>Shadow Chargers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are the bulkier varients of the [[Shadow Creeper (Silksong)|Shadow Creepers]] found deeper within [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]] beneath [[Pharloom]].

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
The Shadow Charger crawls along the ground at a slow pace when idle, turning around once it reaches an edge. Unlike its smaller counterpart, it will not spawn climbing vertically on any walls. When it sees Hornet or if Hornet gets especially close when it is facing away, it rears for a moment and then charges in Hornet's direction, stopping either after Hornet cannot be reached, Hornet gets behind it, or a second has passed since the last time it targeted her. If it reaches an edge, it turns around, which does not cancel the Charge.

Shadow Chargers deal {{Damage|2}} contact damage for all their attacks.

== Location ==
A total of three Shadow Chargers can be found scattered throughout [[The Abyss (Silksong)|the Abyss]], typically in tight corridors.

== Trivia ==
* Shadow Chargers do not respond to the Needolin.
* Shadow Chargers have the highest damage modifier of any enemy, increasing the damage of unupgraded weapons by 250%.
* Unlike their smaller kin, Shadow Chargers bleed out [[Void]] upon death.
